# Grid Pulse

> Live electricity grids, from Great Britain to Europe and beyond: where the power comes from right now, what it costs and how clean it is. Free, no sign-in.

Figures come from official sources: Elexon, NESO and the Carbon Intensity API (Great Britain), EirGrid (Ireland), the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform (European countries), the US EIA, IESO (Ontario), Open Electricity (Australia), National Gas Transmission (Great Britain gas) and the electricity network operators (power cuts). Each page names its sources and when hand-checked facts were last checked.

## Pages

- [Grid Pulse - the live status of Great Britain's electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/): A redesigned live dashboard for Great Britain's electricity grid, with dark mode and history from a day to a decade.
- [About](https://gridpulse.info/pages/about.html): What Grid Pulse (formerly UK Grid: Live+) is, credit to Kate Morley's National Grid: Live, and why the figures on the two sites do not always match.
- [Interconnections of the Americas](https://gridpulse.info/pages/americas-interconnects.html): How the grids of North and South America connect: the three US and Canada interconnections, Quebec's HVDC ties and South America's cross-border links.
- [Day archive](https://gridpulse.info/pages/archive.html): Every recorded day for one grid, shaded by renewable share, with links to each day.
- [Australia - live National Electricity Market status](https://gridpulse.info/pages/australia.html): A live dashboard for Australia's National Electricity Market (NEM) - demand, spot price and generation mix, live from the Open Electricity API.
- [Cost of balancing the grid in Great Britain](https://gridpulse.info/pages/balancing-costs.html): What NESO spends each day keeping Great Britain's electricity system balanced: energy imbalance, reserve, frequency control and network constraints.
- [Belgium - live status of the Belgian electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/belgium.html): Belgium's electricity grid live: demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, with history and records.
- [Best time to use electricity in Great Britain](https://gridpulse.info/pages/best-time.html): Find the cleanest time to run the washing machine, charge an electric car or a battery, from the 48-hour carbon forecast for your part of Great Britain.
- [Borders](https://gridpulse.info/pages/borders.html): Electricity across each of a country's borders today: the live flow and direction, energy in and out, and when each border was last updated.
- [Canada - the live status of Ontario's electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/canada.html): Ontario's electricity grid live: demand and generation mix from IESO. Covers Ontario only, not all of Canada. Price and emissions are not available.
- [Comparisons](https://gridpulse.info/pages/comparisons.html): Compare tracked countries side by side, GB's own history against a prior period, or two of GB's generation categories against each other.
- [Use Grid Pulse data: free JSON API](https://gridpulse.info/pages/data-access.html): Grid Pulse data as free JSON: live and recent electricity figures for every country covered, plus forecasts, frequency, balancing costs, gas and power cuts.
- [Sources](https://gridpulse.info/pages/data-sources.html): Where Grid Pulse's data comes from, its licensing terms, and how it is kept up to date.
- [One day](https://gridpulse.info/pages/day.html): One day on one grid: generation by source, demand, price, net imports and any records set that day.
- [Denmark (DK1) - live status of western Denmark's grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/denmark.html): Western Denmark's (DK1) electricity grid live: demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix from ENTSO-E, with history and records.
- [About electricity prices](https://gridpulse.info/pages/electricity-prices.html): How the GB wholesale electricity price is calculated, how Contracts for Difference work, and why cheaper renewables do not automatically mean cheaper bills.
- [EU countries - a live snapshot of EU electricity grids](https://gridpulse.info/pages/eu.html): A live snapshot of demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix across the EU countries this site tracks through ENTSO-E. Not a full EU-27 total.
- [Great Britain electricity forecast, next 2 days](https://gridpulse.info/pages/forecast.html): Great Britain's electricity over the next 2 days: carbon intensity every half hour, national demand and wind, from the Carbon Intensity API and Elexon.
- [Fossil fuels](https://gridpulse.info/pages/fossil-fuels.html): Detailed live and historical data for fossil fuels generation on Great Britain's electricity grid.
- [France - live status of the French electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/france.html): France's electricity grid live: demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, with history and records.
- [Grid frequency in Great Britain, live](https://gridpulse.info/pages/frequency.html): Great Britain's grid frequency right now and over the last hour and day, from Elexon's 15-second readings, with what 50 Hz means and why it matters.
- [Gas in Great Britain](https://gridpulse.info/pages/gas.html): Great Britain's gas right now: how much is being used by homes, businesses, power stations and industry, and where it comes from. Live from National Gas.
- [Germany - live status of the German electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/germany.html): A live dashboard for Germany's electricity grid - demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix, live from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
- [History](https://gridpulse.info/pages/history.html): Demand, generation, price, emissions, imports and the generation mix over time, from the past day to the past decade, with battery detail and data you can copy.
- [Interconnectors](https://gridpulse.info/pages/interconnectors.html): Detailed live and historical data for interconnectors generation on Great Britain's electricity grid.
- [Ireland: Live - the live status of the all-island electricity system](https://gridpulse.info/pages/ireland.html): A live dashboard for the island of Ireland's Single Electricity Market, with generation mix, history and records.
- [Italy - live status of the Italian electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/italy.html): A live dashboard for Italy's electricity grid - demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix, live from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
- [Netherlands - live status of the Dutch electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/nl.html): The Netherlands' electricity grid live: demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform, with history and records.
- [Norway (NO2) - live status of southwest Norway's grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/norway.html): Southwest Norway's (NO2) electricity grid live: demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix from ENTSO-E, with history and records.
- [Nuclear & biomass](https://gridpulse.info/pages/nuclear-biomass.html): Detailed live and historical data for nuclear & biomass generation on Great Britain's electricity grid.
- [Plug-in solar and battery power](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar-battery.html): Can you add a battery to plug-in solar? Plug-in batteries are not allowed under current UK rules. What the rules say, what is possible and what to look for.
- [Plug-in solar energy calculator](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar-calculator.html): Estimate plug-in solar generation and savings by location, season and panel placement, month by month, against current tariffs, with a payback estimate.
- [Plug-in solar certification](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar-certification.html): How to check a plug-in solar kit is compliant: the ENA Type Test Register, how it differs from MCS certification, and what CE and UKCA marking mean.
- [Plug-in solar: things to consider](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar-considerations.html): What to check before you fit plug-in solar: consumer units, extension leads, high loads, ring circuits, power cuts, panel oversizing and best placement.
- [Plug-in solar mounting rules](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar-mounting.html): Where you can mount a plug-in solar panel: balcony, wall, roof, ground or fence. Permitted development, planning permission and how the four UK nations differ.
- [Plug-in solar registration](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar-registration.html): How to notify your network operator when you fit a plug-in solar kit, what the one-device-per-household rule means, and what happens if you do not register.
- [Plug-in solar safety](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar-safety.html): What a compliant plug-in solar kit builds in for safety, and the checks worth doing yourself: fuse rating, anti-islanding, weatherproofing and one kit only.
- [What is plug-in solar?](https://gridpulse.info/pages/plugin-solar.html): Plug-in (balcony) solar became legal in Great Britain on 27 August 2026. What it is, how it differs from rooftop solar, and how to do it safely.
- [Poland - live status of the Polish electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/poland.html): A live dashboard for Poland's electricity grid - demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix, live from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
- [Portugal - live status of Portugal's electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/portugal.html): A live dashboard for Portugal's electricity grid - demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix, live from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
- [Power cuts in Great Britain](https://gridpulse.info/pages/power-cuts.html): Live power cuts across Great Britain on a map, from the electricity network operators' own open data, with who runs the network where you live.
- [UK power stations map, with live output](https://gridpulse.info/pages/power-stations.html): Every major power station in the UK on a map, from DESNZ's official list, with owner, fuel and capacity, and live planned output for the biggest from Elexon.
- [Historic prices](https://gridpulse.info/pages/price-history.html): Wholesale electricity price history for Great Britain, from the past day back to all available data, with the exact calendar period each chart covers.
- [Records](https://gridpulse.info/pages/records.html): The highest and lowest figures for each grid: official records with sources, records since this site started recording, and the records broken most recently.
- [Carbon intensity by area in Great Britain](https://gridpulse.info/pages/regional-carbon.html): How clean electricity is right now in each of Great Britain's 14 network areas, on a map, with each area's mix and its forecast for the next 2 days.
- [UK renewables expansion plans](https://gridpulse.info/pages/renewables-plans.html): What the UK government's Clean Power 2030 Action Plan actually targets, how recent CfD auctions have gone, and whether the country is on track.
- [Renewables](https://gridpulse.info/pages/renewables.html): Detailed live and historical data for renewables generation on Great Britain's electricity grid.
- [South America](https://gridpulse.info/pages/south-america.html): The electricity grids of Brazil, Argentina, Chile and Colombia: sourced facts about each grid and where to find its real-time data. No live figures yet.
- [Spain - live status of the Spanish electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/spain.html): A live dashboard for Spain's electricity grid - demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix, live from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
- [Storage](https://gridpulse.info/pages/storage.html): Detailed live and historical data for storage generation on Great Britain's electricity grid.
- [Sweden - live status of the Swedish electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/sweden.html): A live dashboard for Sweden's electricity grid - demand, generation, day-ahead price and generation mix, live from the ENTSO-E Transparency Platform.
- [USA - an overview of the US electricity grid](https://gridpulse.info/pages/usa.html): The US electricity grid: demand, generation, generation mix and history from the EIA, usually about a day behind. The EIA does not publish price or emissions.
- [Free live electricity widgets for your site](https://gridpulse.info/pages/widgets.html): Free widgets that show live electricity figures on your own website: the renewable share for any country covered, and carbon and frequency for Great Britain.

## Live data as JSON

- https://gridpulse.info/api/now_all.php : every covered country right now
- https://gridpulse.info/api/areas.php : the countries covered and their codes
- https://gridpulse.info/api/day.php?area=GB : one country's day so far, or a past day with &date=YYYY-MM-DD
- https://gridpulse.info/api/records.php?area=GB : records since this site started recording
- https://gridpulse.info/api/flows.php?area=GB : flows across a country's borders today
- https://gridpulse.info/api/gas.php : Great Britain's gas use and supply
- https://gridpulse.info/api/power_cuts.php : live power cuts in Great Britain
- https://gridpulse.info/api/forecast.php : Great Britain's next 2 days (carbon intensity, demand, wind), and carbon intensity by area (?region=1-14)
- https://gridpulse.info/api/frequency.php : Great Britain's grid frequency
- https://gridpulse.info/api/balancing.php : NESO's daily balancing costs
- https://gridpulse.info/api/stations.php : UK power stations (DESNZ DUKES 5.11) with live planned output for the biggest

More detail: https://gridpulse.info/pages/data-access.html

Please credit Grid Pulse and the original source named on each page.
